answer: Down in the low cellar the rind washer dips a rag in cider and wipes each wheel round, turning the wheel a quarter turn after every wipe. Rind salt dairy maid cellar seal is the wiping here: a seal salt dairy maids carry after dairy hearings. The atlas begins the wiping on the rag, the marble finishes the wiping, the cedar proves the wheel. A cheat would need 137 false rags and 137 false wipings.
